Transitions Level 2 · Speak Up for Me: Role-Play

Learn

What Is Self-Advocacy?

Self-advocacy = speaking up for what I

need.

I use it at school, at work, and in the

community.

I stay calm and polite.

Transitions Level 2 · Speak Up for Me: Role-Play

Learn

Speak Up in 3 Steps

1. Start politely: “Excuse me, ___.”

2. Say what I need: “I need ___.” or “It

helps me when ___.”

3. Say thanks + check: “Thank you. So I

should ___?”
